answer: Volkswagen targets a 50.4% absolute reduction in production Scope 1 and 2 by 2030 from 2018 (baseline 9.03 MtCO2e), accounted market-based; by end-2025 it reported a 60% reduction. The target was SBTi-validated as aligned with 1.5°C. For Scope 3 Category 11 use-phase emissions of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles, it targets a 30% reduction from 2018 to 2030, from a recalculated baseline of 191.5 gCO2e per vehicle-km; SBTi confirmed alignment with a maximum 2°C pathway. No separate 2025 percentage progress for this use-phase target is stated in the frozen window.
